mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_detail(address, order_code, created_at, phone_number, status, total_price, voucher_code, user_id) VALUES (#{orderInfo.address}, #{orderInfo.orderCode}, NOW(), #{orderInfo.phoneNumber}, 'PENDING', #{orderInfo.totalPrice}, #{orderInfo.voucherCode}, #{orderInfo.userId})
INSERT INTO order_item(price_at_order_time, quantity, order_id, product_id) VALUES (#{orderItemInfo.priceAtOrderTime}, #{orderItemInfo.quantity}, #{orderItemInfo.orderId}, #{orderItemInfo.productId})
mapper.select:
SELECT od.id AS id, od.address AS address, od.phone_number AS phoneNumber, od.created_at AS createdAt, od.status AS orderStatus, od.voucher_code AS voucherCode, od.total_price AS totalPrice, od.checkout_url AS checkoutUrl, od.order_code AS orderCode, oi.id AS o_id, oi.price_at_order_time AS o_price, oi.quantity AS o_quantity, oi.order_id AS o_orderId, oi.product_id AS o_productId, p.name AS o_productName, p.product_image AS o_productImage FROM order_detail od INNER JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = od.id INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE od.user_id = #{userId}
AND od.status = #{orderStatus}

SELECT od.id AS id, od.address AS address, od.phone_number AS phoneNumber, od.created_at AS createdAt, od.status AS orderStatus, od.voucher_code AS voucherCode, od.total_price AS totalPrice, od.checkout_url AS checkoutUrl, od.order_code AS orderCode, oi.id AS o_id, oi.price_at_order_time AS o_price, oi.quantity AS o_quantity, oi.order_id AS o_orderId, oi.product_id AS o_productId, p.name AS o_productName, p.product_image AS o_productImage FROM order_detail od INNER JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = od.id INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE od.id = #{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_detail od WHERE od.status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_detail od WHERE od.status = 'SUCCESS'
